review_description: We got a great quote almost immediately after going through my existing solar system.Quote came in about half the cost of a whole-house option from a competitor. This is a lesser system...but $10k less cost.I was expecting install to be months later, but they came the following week.Great team who obviously knew their stuff and got my two batteries and the new inverter set up and running in good order.A couple of teething problems with configuration and the app on my phone, but they are always approachable and proactively follow-up to check all ok...even after I'd paid the bill. :)

Can't fault them on their work quality.

I can not speak highly enough of Smiley and his team at Watts Up Electrical. The initial sales process was thorough and although they were very knowledgeable, I felt they over sold the potential results. The install date was changed twice and then a third was set when the installers came and delivered the equipment, they informed me the install date was going to be changed again. At this point the installer had only sent 2 of his junior guys as he was still on the mainland taking his kids to school, so he wasn't due till later in the morning. I'd had enough by this stage and told them to cancel the order and take the equipment back. They got on the phone and begged me to have some "humanity". I should have stuck to my guns but relented and allowed them to get the job done. On the 2nd day one of the young guys fell whilst on the roof, so he left the job and didn't return. The other young guy on the job also left as he had a pre-existing leg injury and didn't return as well, which left the sparky on his own for the rest of the week. To his credit he worked till dark each night, my wife and I fed him and even lent him our mainland car so he didn't have to take his truck on the barge. The job was finished after about 5 days and all was good...for now. Since then, I have rang the sparky and left messages several times but not once has he returned a call. I have had a number of teething issues which need sorting including CT clamps that need to be changed, so I managed to get one of the other sparkies on site to rectify. I have been getting about 25-30kw per day solar production, which is about half what I was told I should get. I have made a number of emails, calls and texts to Smiley, but his communication is non-existent and when you do get him on the phone, he fobs you off and cant get off the phone quick enough. Bottom line- I spent $28000 on a 13kw solar and 13kw battery system and the one thing I would not do is recommend either Wattup Solar and Ultimate Electrical.
